esr.definition:
n the rate at which red blood cells settle out in a tube of blood under standardized conditions; a high rate usually indicates the presence of inflammation
n microwave spectroscopy in which there is resonant absorption of radiation by a paramagnet

esrd.translation: [医][=end-stage renal disease]终末期肾脏疾病，晚期肾病

esrf.translation: [医][=end-stage renal failure]终末期肾功衰竭，晚期功能衰竭

esri.translation: abbr. Economic and Social Research Institute (Dublin) 经济和社会研究所（都柏林）; electron spin resonance imaging 电子自旋共振成像
